subject: Superintendent Evaluation Template Selection
overview: The subcommittee met to determine the format and process for the 2022-23 superintendent evaluation, ultimately selecting a standardized state template over a custom format.

items.title: Superintendent Evaluation Template Options
items.summary: Approved the use of the Department of Elementary and Secondary Education (DESE) template for the superintendent evaluation instead of a custom Google Sheet. The committee debated the merits of data aggregation efficiency versus the standardization provided by the official state form.

items.title: Evaluation Instructions and Timeline
items.summary: Reviewed draft instructions for the evaluation process and scheduled a follow-up meeting for April 24 to finalize materials before the full committee review on May 8.
